author.description: Author snapshot at time of scraping (id, username, displayName, followerCount, etc.)
author.title: Author

authorStats.description: Follower, following, heart, video and digg counts for the author
authorStats.title: Author Stats

carriesAnyHashtag.description: True when the video's caption carries at least one hashtag entity
carriesAnyHashtag.title: Carries Any Hashtag

carriesSearchedHashtag.description: True when the video's own hashtag entities include the searched tag
carriesSearchedHashtag.title: Carries Searched Hashtag

collectCount.description: Number of times post was saved/collected
collectCount.title: Collect Count

createTime.description: Unix timestamp when the post was created
createTime.title: Create Time

duetEnabled.description: Whether duets are allowed on this post
duetEnabled.title: Duet Enabled

hashtag.description: The requested hashtag (without #) on stats rows
hashtag.title: Hashtag

hashtagName.description: Canonical hashtag name as TikTok stores it
hashtagName.title: Hashtag Name

hashtags.description: Hashtags used in the post, each with id and name
hashtags.title: Hashtags

images.description: Slideshow images for photo posts (postType='slideshow'). Each item has ordinal, width, height, urlList.
images.title: Images

isAd.description: Whether the post is a paid advertisement
isAd.title: Is Ad

isCommerce.description: Whether this is a commercial/brand hashtag
isCommerce.title: Is Commerce

locationCreated.description: Country code where the post was created
locationCreated.title: Location Created

mediaUrlExpiresAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when signed media URLs expire
mediaUrlExpiresAt.title: Media URL Expires At

mentions.description: @mentions in the caption with username and offsets
mentions.title: Mentions

music.description: Music/sound used in the post (id, title, authorName, duration, playUrl, coverUrl)
music.title: Music

position.description: 1-based position in the collected feed/search list for the hashtag
position.title: Position

postUrl.description: Direct URL to the TikTok post
postUrl.title: Post URL

profileLarger.description: Large profile/cover image URL for the hashtag
profileLarger.title: Profile Image (Large)

profileMedium.description: Medium profile image URL for the hashtag
profileMedium.title: Profile Image (Medium)

profileThumb.description: Thumbnail profile image URL for the hashtag
profileThumb.title: Profile Image (Thumb)

recordType.description: Discriminator: 'hashtag_metadata' for aggregate stats rows, 'post' for video rows
recordType.title: Record Type

region.description: Market used for the run (US is the verified feed market)
region.title: Region

scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when the record was built
scrapedAt.title: Scraped At

searchedHashtag.description: The normalized hashtag input that produced this record (without #)
searchedHashtag.title: Searched Hashtag

shareEnabled.description: Whether sharing is enabled on this post
shareEnabled.title: Share Enabled

shareMeta.description: Share metadata object with title and desc fields
shareMeta.title: Share Meta

source.description: 'challenge_detail' on stats rows; 'feed' or 'search' on video rows
source.title: Source

stitchEnabled.description: Whether stitching is allowed on this post
stitchEnabled.title: Stitch Enabled

textExtra.description: Raw TikTok caption entities (hashtags and mentions) when present
textExtra.title: Text Extra

textLanguage.description: Language code of the caption text
textLanguage.title: Text Language

video.description: Video metadata (width, height, duration, ratio, playUrl, cover)
video.title: Video

videoCount.description: All-time number of videos using this hashtag, from statsV2 (string to avoid overflow)
videoCount.title: Video Count

viewCount.description: All-time views across all videos using this hashtag, from statsV2 (string)
viewCount.title: View Count

title: TikTok Hashtag Stats and Video Feed Dataset
